title: Alarm spontaneously changed without my intervention.
body: One day, out of nowhere, my alarm set for 8AM every day turned off without my asking. I had to turn it on again manually despite not having changed my sleep schedule program. It was extremely upsetting, as it affected my work attendance for two days in a row.
author: mariosibrianz

title: Upgrade cycle tracking
body: First of all the app is amazing, but on the Cucle Tracking feature it would be nice if I can also track my menstrual phases, such as Luteal phase and ovulation. And also the app should educate more about the phases and how can we overcome many symptoms. Thanks, hope we can have an empathy upgrade someday!
author: Rsdarsda
